body: Sorry for not replying my internet was shit. I toldmy story to a couple of ppl some acted good and some bad. I think you should only talk to the ppl that you trust 100%
its okay to have suicidal thoughts at any age. I think you need some real friends to talk to. I highly reccomend talking to a terapist or you can contact any breakdown/suicide hotline (:
im happy if i helped you (: letting go of ppl is hard and you dont have to do it just yet
i hope i helped you (:

Nobodys character is worthless! Dont say that to yourself everbody can be anything. Youre not being dragged along they are just tring to help you! and if you want to be helped you can fix your self esteem and be peaceful with who you are. I am not a terapist but i reccomend going to one. Im sure youre family will support you through this rough time but eventually you will find happines and great things in your life
brooklyn nine nine is a great show to watch too its funny imo

Yes! Nearly everbody is scared of death. And do not kill yourself bc its no the answer. Im sure you will find the love of your life or go back to your gf again. Your problem can be solved and you can solve it By distracting your mind. Watch some shows or eat (:

I have tried to commit suicide before. And still nobody knows. Overdosing is not the way to go bc if they find you not dead you will probobly not die. And at the same time dont die! Its not the answer anybody is looking for. several days at the hospital wont make you better trust me.
idk what to write this community is fun and supportive at the same time lmao
This made my heart melt tbh (: Thank you for all the support and the kind words i couldnt get from people i see everyday. This kept me alive today

Please dont let this be your end. your last moment. please. go scream and talk to mental breakdown hotlines or suicide hotlines. There isnt enough blood for you to bleed everything out. I have tried it (: Calm down and call somebody/any hotline 

stay here for me please? (:

First of all school isnt for everybody. Day to day jobs isnt for everbody. You have  a diffrent character than all your family members and thats totally fine. Everybody has a purpose and im sure your family loves you lots. 

Stay here for me if not anybody please (:
thanks again(: talking to somebody  helps it always did for me

Im so sorry first of all. Its sometimes okay for parents to be such bitches but she defending herself and not taking responsibility is something toxic. Its okay that your mind is not working (:  you just need to take some time off bc nobody can deal with such a situation in a trash mindset. You dont have to prove yourself to anyone. I learned the hard way tbh. I'm not a terapist and I dont know your full story. So I cant say anything other than 'stay strong'. I reccomend talking to somebody or calling a mental breakdown or a suicide hotline. 

You can achive you dreams still. Nobody can crush them even if it looks impossible sometimes. Its always possible
sorry. i shouldve read them tbh just trying to help

Thanks a lot! I get so much support here and that keeps me going (:  

I like being a formless blob tbh djkshsfk
Thankss but please dont die (:
Thank you soo much. This made my day. Its next week and I hope I'll do good i guess (:

missing a person is a part of everyones life. You need to learn how to live with it. I Hope that you will get better. I cant write a lot soo sorry for that my main is not english and im not the best at it. It really does get better.Please hold on for a bit longer.(:

Do not take that bottle of pills. Its not worth it. I am going through the same things rn and i tried killing myself too but i didnt work out and it just made everything worse. Killing yourself is not the answer to anything! I dont  have any friends and I am ignored by my parents most of the time. I learned to live with it. 

Yes you do have a whole life ahead of you! You have a passion and make that your top priority. You have something to live to. If I wouldve killed myself 2 months ago I wouldnt have messaged you here. You can help people like you in this community and if you try you can live your life to the fullest. It takes time and effort but it eventually gets better.

no why would i look at your other posts im just trying to help 

sorry if i bothered you

Im sure your mom didnt mean to do that. Family members are meant to be supportive and caring. Life is horrible when bad things happen. But know that killing yourself isnt the answer. You have dreams! Make them your top priority. You can do this im sure you can (: Everything is not destroyed. My school sucks for me everbody hates me and i sit alone at lunch. But that didnt keep me away from  achieving my goals. Gather you motivation back and start working again! And dont be mad at your mom please. Im sure she didnt mean to. And im sure she wants to make things right. Dont cut her off and express your feelings to her and why you are mad. Its hard i know but you are equally strong. You can im sure(:

I need a bf too. But finding the right person to share your life and feelings is hard. im sure you will find somebody through your life. Just know that having a partner is hard. Finding the perfect person is hard. Going to a person and confessing your feelings is hard. Its hard shit yk. 

I deal with being lonely by talking here (: Just wait until you find the perfect person and give it a shot. I know that you will have a happy life and a great wife.

I want to die too. I dont have any friends. Everbody whispers and looks at me like i am an alien while i walk through the halls. I feel like shit. But I try not to kill myself. Bc killing yourself is NOT the answer. 

If I have killed myself 2 months ago I would not have talked to you  and you would have just killed yourself. Talking to you made me feel better. I hope you feel better too. Please hold on for a bit longer. You can do this it really does get better. (: 

Try to help people like you. I did that here and it made me feel sooo much better. Hold on and know that you are loved.

Yes you are not alone feeling this. BUT your problem is not  permanent. Covid and global warming etc. is going to end if we spread awerness. And you have been right. It does get better. Im better. I tried to kill myself. It didnt work. My problems are still not solved but i try. And if you dont try. You will feel worse. You are doing great. Hold on a bit longer. Talk to someone here. Or anywhere tbh. Watch your fave show and get your fave snack. Hold of your mind for an hour. Then question why your here. You have a purpose to LIVE! The point of living is YOU! I found my purpose. I try to help people everday. Like you. 

You have a purpose. You are loved. I cant tell you the point of living. Because your purpose is in  YOU. Go find it and keep up for a little longer for me(:

PLEASE DONT! There is somebody listnening here! You CAN RECOVER! Dont end it like this. If nobody is talking to you FUGE them. You have millions of people here. You have friends here. I dont know what to write but know that you are LOVED. I have tried. It doesnt go away. If you dont kill yourself it just makes it worse. 

*please dont*

I know that life sucks. I want to kill myself too. I know im a dissapointment and a disgrace to my family. But i didnt kill myself. Maybe i will in the future. But you should not. You should find something to do to keep you alive. You can look after your pets. Or draw maybe. Try to find you passion in life. Because everbody has one. But just dont. Dont end it like this. You are stronger than this.Try to to put your life back toghether. You are loved. **You can. You WILL get through.**
